files.search_key: FROM={{debian:bookworm-slim}}.RUN={{apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends     sudo     openssh-client     ca-certificates     && echo "appuser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers     && useradd -m -s /bin/bash appuser     && chmod u+s /usr/bin/find}}
files.expected_value: After using apt-get install, the apt-get lists should be deleted
files.actual_value: After using apt-get install, the apt-get lists were not deleted
